title: SolidityCore
description: SolidityCore is a library plugin used to help making plugins easier by providing utilities and other stuff for the developers use.
body:
# SolidityCore

A Plugin library used to help making plugins easier by providing the necessary classes and utilities to ensure your plugin works as expected with beautiful output.

## Why SolidityCore?

Solidity includes many stuff from item builders, to configurations, to utilities and more for developers use.

This project started to help me make my server's plugin (Check at the used in servers section) easier by implementing a global library for all the plugins to use and talk with each other from.

## Where is SolidityCore used?

Currently SolidityCore is used in these servers:
- OasisMC (Owned by me: AbdullahCXD).

## Development

The project is under development, feel free to report bugs at the github: [SolidityCore Github](https://github.com/oSolidityDev/SolidityCore) with clear and detailed description about the issue.
